sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Christine M. Mosby.
American Fork City’s Transparent Utah compensation records list Christine M. Mosby as an Intern in fiscal year 2016 and a Human Resources Specialist in fiscal years 2017 and 2018.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records report compensation for Christine M. Mosby’s work for American Fork City in fiscal years 2016 through 2018. The latest listed position in this export is Human Resources Specialist.
Compensation years reflect reported pay and do not establish exact hire or departure dates.

sections.title: Lawsuits
descriptions: Mosby v. American Fork City, Case No. 2:18-cv-00940-CMR. The complaint and civil cover sheet were filed on December 10, 2018.
The PACER docket records a stipulated motion to dismiss and an order granting dismissal on September 25, 2020. Each party was ordered to pay its own attorney’s fees and costs.
